_meta.description: Meta is an opaque payload with extended meta data details of the plugin.

description.description: Description is the description of the plugin.

icons.description: Icons is the list of icons for the plugin.

label.description: Label is the label of the icon.

size.description: Size is the size of the icon.

src.description: Src is the source of the icon.

type.description: Type is the type of the icon.

license.description: License is the SPDX license identifier of the plugin.

metadata.description:
Metadata is the official metadata of the plugin as reported in the
plugin manifest file.

name.description:
Name is the name of the plugin.
The format is that of identifiers, e.g. "my-plugin".

namespace.description:
Namespace is the namespace of the plugin.
The format is reverse-DNS, e.g. "io.github.user".

packages.description: Packages is the list of packages for the plugin.

commit.description: Commit is the commit of the package.

digest.description: Digest is the digest of the package.

identifier.description: Identifier is the OCI identifier of the package.

mediaType.description: MediaType is the media type of the package.

ref.description: Ref is the reference of the package.

registryType.description:
RegistryType is the type of registry the package is from.
Can be "oci" or "git".

subfolder.description: Subfolder is the subfolder of the package.

url.description: URL is the URL of the package.

provenance.description:
Provenance contains the expected certificate identity and attestation
constraints for the plugin artifact.
provenance.title: registry.Provenance

repository.description: Repository is the source repository of the plugin.

type.description: Type is the type of the repository.

url.description: URL is the URL of the repository.

repository.title: registry.SkillRepository

status.description:
Status is the status of the plugin.
Can be one of "active", "deprecated", or "archived".

title.description:
Title is the title of the plugin.
This is for human consumption, not an identifier.

version.description:
Version is the version of the plugin.
Any non-empty string is valid, but ideally it should be either a
semantic version or a commit hash.
